response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref AS project_reference, pr.fundflux AS funding_source, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.avg_rate AS gap_above_benchmark FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A project's size-per-minute rate is computed as total gbsize ÷ total spanmin across all its scans (not the average of per-scan rates)
Scans with NULL or missing gbsize or spanmin values are excluded from rate calculations
Scans with spanmin ≤ 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero or nonsensical rates

alternatives.interpretation: Each project's rate is the average of its per-scan rates: AVG(gbsize / spanmin) instead of SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin)
